status.description: active: approve a store in review, or re-approve one staff rejected / deactivated (opens it on its opening hours — clears the merchant's manual open/closed override — clears its note, and verifies every document it has at that moment, i.e. what the reviewer saw at expected_updated_at; already active → 200, nothing changes); refused with 409 code owner_leaving while the owner has an account deletion request pending or completed. inactive: reject a store in review or deactivate a live one (note required; closes it; allowed even while the owner is leaving). Otherwise 409 code invalid_state

expected_updated_at.description: The store's updated_at the reviewer saw: another instant → 409 code stale

status.description: Blink's verdict on the document's current value (the scan URL / the NIF or NIS number). It stops counting once the merchant replaces that value (the document is pending again). The same verdict (and reason) on the same value → 200, nothing changes

reason.description: Required to reject; shown to the merchant

expected_value.description: The document value the reviewer looked at (stores.documents: commercial_register_front_url / commercial_register_back_url / nif / nis): another current value → 409 code stale

review_status.description: approved: from pending / rejected; rejected: from pending / approved (note required). Anything else changes nothing (200, no notification)

suggestion_status.description: accepted: a pending or declined suggestion becomes the live price; rejected: a pending one only (note required). Otherwise 409

note.description: Required to reject a product or a price

expected_suggested_price.description: The suggested price the reviewer saw. Checked on suggestion decisions: a different (or no) suggestion now → 409 code stale

expected_updated_at.description: The product's updated_at the reviewer saw. Checked on review_status decisions only (stock sales bump it): another instant → 409 code stale

status.description: active: approve a pack in review; inactive: reject one in review or deactivate a live one (note required). Otherwise 409 code invalid_state

expected_updated_at.description: The pack's updated_at the reviewer saw: another instant → 409 code stale
